definitions.short: a knot (as tied up), i.e. (figuratively) a riddle ; also a vertebra (as if a knot)
definitions.full: H7001. qetar [ קְטַר ] noun masculine Dan 5:6 joint, knot ; — literal plural construct קִטְרֵי 5:6 joints of his loin; figurative absolute קִטְרִין 5:12 ; 5:16 , usually knotty things , difficulties (Syriac PS 3591 ); but probably of magic spells, banns (also Syriac PS l.c. , compare Brock 319b ), so Bev, see also Dr.
